name: Aurebako
backstory: Child of Aurebalo and Merluko in Gorff; raised alongside sells iron work at the market through the..., having heard about CONFLICT-02.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Learned that Khaus has died.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Khaubalo and Mekestros now have a child, Khaubestro.
Heard that Aurebalo and Mekoboro now have a child, Aurekobo.
Heard that Aurebalo and Khaoboro now have a child, Aurekhobo.
Heard that Khaubalo and Merluko now have a child, Merkhaubo.
Heard that Merluko and Khaubalo now have a child, Khaubaluk.
Heard that Aureluko and Mekhaubo now have a child, Mekhaurel.
Had a child with Khaoboro, named Khaobako.
Heard that Khaumestro and Aurekobo now have a child, Aurekomest.
Heard that Aureluko and Mekhaubo now have a child, Mekaurelo.
Heard that Mekhaurel and Khaobako now have a child, Mekhaobako.
Heard that Khaobako and Mekhaurel now have a child, Mekhaobera.
Heard that Mekhaubo and Aureluko now have a child, Mekaurelu.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only if it stayed close to Birth Of Niergus
criterion.wasted_life: a life spent never once engaging with Birth Of Niergus
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: minds the iron stall through the day, counts every delivery twice the way his father counts his own commissions, hasn't yet decided which trade he wants to keep

arc.premise: Aurebako has started stockpiling raw iron at his own stall - buying up ingots now, while supply is still steady - so the arrears dispute can't leave his forge sitting empty the way it once starved his father's for three seasons running.
